page.layout: One printed page. Page number at top left. Running title "Futurum" centred above the text in italic. Main text in one column: a two-column conjugation table (Italian/Latin forms left, German translations right, with a bracket marking "verlieren" and "ren." at right), then headings and paragraphs. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Futurum
Imperatiui modi. tempus præs.
main_text.p: Perda tu, perda colui, verliere du, verliere er.
Perdiamo noi, perdiate voi, verlieren wir, verlieret jhr.
main_text.head: Futurum Imperat.
Optatiui modi subjunct.
main_text.p: Dio voglia che io perda, tu perda, colui perda, Noi perdiamo, voi perdiate, coloro perdano. Wolte Gott daß ich verlier, du verlierst, er verlierte. Wir verlieren, jhr verlieret, daß sie verlieren.
main_text.head: Præteritum perfectum.
main_text.p: Iddio volesse, che io perdessi, tu perdessi, colui per- desse, Noi

page.notes: The conjugation table's bracket at right groups "verlieren" and "ren." (a bracket spanning the German infinitive); the left column lines are transcribed as lines. Final line is cut off at the foot ("Noi" continues beyond the page). Some Italian and German forms are partly faint; "perderà" and "verlieren" read as printed.
